questions.stem: Suppose that the angles of two sectors are equal, and the radius of the larger sector is equal to three times the radius of the smaller sectors. questions.stem: \(O\) is the centre of the sector \(OAB\). The ratio of its radius to its arc length is \(2:3\). If the area of the sector \(OAB\) is \(192\text{ cm}^2\), which of the following are true? I. \(\angle AOB<90^\circ\) II. The radius of the sector \(OAB\) is 16 cm. III. The perimeter of \(\triangle OAB\) is less than 54 cm.
questions.stemZh:
O 為扇形 OAB 的圓心，其半徑與弧長之比為 2:3，面積為 \(192\text{ cm}^2\)。下列哪些敘述正確？
I. \(\angle AOB<90^\circ\)
II. 半徑為 16 cm。
III. 三角形 OAB 的周界小於 54 cm。
questions.hint: Use arc length \(l=r\theta\) and sector area \(A=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\).
questions.hintZh: 運用扇形弧長公式 \(l=r\theta\) 同埋扇形面積公式 \(A=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\)。
questions.solution: With arc length s = 3r/2, \(192=rs/2=3r^2/4\), so r = 16 and s = 24. The angle is \(24(360)/(2\pi(16))\approx85.94^\circ\), so I and II are true. By the cosine rule, \(AB=\sqrt{16^2+16^2-2(16)^2\cos85.94^\circ}\approx21.81\) cm. Thus the triangle perimeter is approximately 53.81 cm, below 54 cm. All three are true; answer D.
questions.solutionZh: 由弧長 \(s=3r/2\) 及 \(192=rs/2=3r^2/4\)，得 r = 16、s = 24。圓心角為 \(24(360)/(2\pi(16))\approx85.94^\circ\)，故 I、II 正確。由餘弦公式，弦長 \(AB\approx21.81\) cm，三角形周界約為 53.81 cm，小於 54 cm，故 III 亦正確。答案 D。

questions.stem: A right circular cone has height 12 cm and base radius 9 cm. Its upper cone is removed by a plane parallel to the base, leaving a frustum of height 8 cm. Find the volume of the frustum.
questions.stemZh: 一直立圓錐高 12 cm、底半徑 9 cm。用平行於底面的平面切去頂部小圓錐，留下高 8 cm 的截頭錐。求截頭錐的體積。
questions.solution: The removed cone has height \(12-8=4\) cm, so its radius is \(9(4/12)=3\) cm. The frustum volume is \(\frac13\pi(9^2\cdot12-3^2\cdot4)=312\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Answer: B.
questions.solutionZh: 切去小錐高 \(12-8=4\) cm，半徑 \(9(4/12)=3\) cm。截頭錐體積 \(\frac13\pi(9^2\cdot12-3^2\cdot4)=312\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。答案 B。

questions.stem: The base of a right pyramid is a rectangle. The length and the breadth of the base are 18 cm and 16 cm respectively. The height of the pyramid is 12 cm. The pyramid is divided into a pyramid \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane parallel to its base. If the breadth of the base of \(X\) is 12 cm, then the volume of \(Y\) is
questions.stemZh: 一直立錐體的底面為長方形，長 18 cm、闊 16 cm，高為 12 cm。用平行於底面的平面將它分成上方小錐體 X 及下方截頭錐 Y。若 X 的底面闊為 12 cm，求 Y 的體積。
questions.hint: Pyramid volume = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 錐體體積 = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
questions.solution: The original volume is \(18(16)(12)/3=1152\text{ cm}^3\). The small pyramid has length scale \(12/16=3/4\), so its volume is \(1152(3/4)^3=486\text{ cm}^3\). The frustum volume is \(1152-486=666\text{ cm}^3\). Answer B.

questions.stem: The base radius of a circular cone is 6 cm. The upper part of the circular cone is cut so that a frustum with height half of the height of the circular cone is made. If the volume of the frustum is 168π cm³, find the height of the frustum.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓錐的底半徑為 \(6\) cm。切除圓錐的上部，造成一個高為圓錐高一半的截頭錐。若截頭錐的體積為 \(168\pi\text{ cm}^3\)，求截頭錐的高。
questions.hint: Frustum = large cone - small cone. Use similarity ratio.
questions.hintZh: 截頭錐 = 大錐 - 細錐。相似體比例係關鍵。
questions.solution: Let the original cone height be H. The removed cone has half its height and one eighth its volume. Thus \(168\pi=(7/8)(1/3)\pi(6)^2H\), so H = 16 cm. The frustum height is H/2 = 8 cm. Answer C.
questions.solutionZh: 設原圓錐高為 H。切去的小圓錐高為一半，體積為原來的八分之一。因此 \(168\pi=(7/8)(1/3)\pi(6)^2H\)，得 H = 16 cm。截頭錐高為 H/2 = 8 cm，選 C。

questions.stem: A solid metal sphere is put into an empty container in the shape of a right circular cylinder. The container is placed on a horizontal table. The internal base diameter of the container is equal to the diameter of the sphere. Water is then poured into the container until the water level just reaches the top of the sphere. If the depth of the water in the container is 6 cm after the sphere is removed, then the surface area of the sphere is
questions.stemZh: 一實心金屬球放在水平桌上的空直立圓柱形容器內。容器內底直徑等於球的直徑。加水至剛好到達球頂，然後取出球。若此時水深為 6 cm，求球的表面積。
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=2\pi r h\). Total area = curved + 2 circles.
questions.hintZh: 圓柱曲面面積 = \(2\pi r h\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 2個圓。
questions.solution: Let the sphere radius be r cm. Before removal the water volume is \(2\pi r^3-4\pi r^3/3=2\pi r^3/3\). After removal it is \(\pi r^2(6)\). Hence \(r=3(6)/2=9\) cm. The surface area is \(4\pi r^2=324\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Answer A.
questions.solutionZh: 設球半徑為 r cm。取球前水的體積為 \(2\pi r^3-4\pi r^3/3=2\pi r^3/3\)。取球後為 \(\pi r^2(6)\)。因此 \(r=3(6)/2=9\) cm，球表面積為 \(4\pi r^2=324\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，選 A。

questions.stem: A solid consists of a hemisphere of radius \(r\) cm joined at its flat base to the upper base of a right circular frustum. The frustum has upper radius \(r\), lower radius \(2r\), and height \(2r\). Find the total volume.
questions.stemZh: 一立體由半徑 \(r\) cm 的半球及一直立圓錐的截頭錐組成，半球平面與截頭錐上底接合。截頭錐上底半徑為 \(r\)、下底半徑為 \(2r\)、高為 \(2r\)。求總體積。
questions.solution: Frustum volume \(=\frac13\pi(2r)[(2r)^2+(2r)r+r^2]=\frac{14}{3}\pi r^3\). Add hemisphere volume \(\frac23\pi r^3\): total \(\frac{16}{3}\pi r^3\text{ cm}^3\). Answer: A.
questions.solutionZh: 截頭錐體積 \(=\frac13\pi(2r)[(2r)^2+(2r)r+r^2]=\frac{14}{3}\pi r^3\)。加上半球體積 \(\frac23\pi r^3\)，總體積為 \(\frac{16}{3}\pi r^3\text{ cm}^3\)。答案 A。

questions.stem: A solid consists of a right circular frustum and a hemisphere. The frustum is 8 cm high, with base radii 5 cm and 3 cm, and the hemisphere has radius 5 cm. They meet along their common circular base of radius 5 cm. Find the total volume.
questions.stemZh: 一立體由一直立圓錐的截頭錐及半球組成。截頭錐高 8 cm，上下底半徑分別為 3 cm 及 5 cm；半球半徑為 5 cm。兩部分沿半徑為 5 cm 的共同圓形底面接合。求總體積。
questions.solution: The frustum volume is \(\frac{8\pi}{3}(5^2+5\cdot3+3^2)=\frac{392}{3}\pi\). The hemisphere volume is \(\frac23\pi(5)^3=\frac{250}{3}\pi\). The total is \(214\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Answer: C.

questions.stem: A metal sphere has volume \(972\pi\text{ cm}^3\). It is melted and recast, without loss of material, into a cylinder of height 18 cm. Find the exact radius of the cylinder.
questions.stemZh: 一金屬球的體積為 \(972\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。將它熔化並重鑄成高 18 cm 的圓柱，過程中沒有材料損失。求圓柱半徑的準確值。
questions.hint: Sphere volume \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\), surface area \(=4\pi r^2\).
questions.hintZh: 球體積 \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，球面積 \(=4\pi r^2\)。半球總面積 \(=3\pi r^2\)。
questions.solution: Conservation of volume gives \(18\pi r^2=972\pi\), hence \(r^2=54\) and \(r=3\sqrt6\) cm (the positive root). None of the original MC choices equals this value.
questions.solutionZh: 由體積守恆，\(18\pi r^2=972\pi\)，所以 \(r^2=54\)。半徑取正值，故 \(r=3\sqrt6\) cm。原來的四個選項均不等於此值。
